photos.alt: The colonial before construction, seen head-on from the street: a two-story main house beside a single-story two-car garage wing sitting under a lower roofline, with tan siding and brown shutters
The same house before construction from the driveway, showing the garage wing roof meeting the main house well below the second-floor windows
Rear of the house before construction, with the original single-story wing, brick chimney, and a raised deck off the back overlooking the yard

The new second story mid-build, framed and dried in: stud walls and roof rafters exposed, exterior sheathing and insulation board in place, double-hung windows set, and rough electrical run to open boxes over a bare subfloor

Second-floor hallway mid-build, looking down the framed corridor: exposed stud walls and roof rafters, flexible duct and wiring run overhead, recessed light housings hung, and new windows set above a bare subfloor
The house from the driveway mid-build, with the new second story sheathed over the garage, roof shingled and windows installed, and a skip and work truck in the drive
A framed second-floor bedroom with vaulted rafters overhead, three new windows set, recessed light housings hung, and the first sheets of drywall stacked against the studs
The rear elevation mid-build, with the new second story sheathed and roofed above the original single-story wing, standing alongside the brick chimney

The new bathroom mid-tile, with blue onyx-look large-format tile set on the shower walls behind yellow levelling clips, a recessed niche framed out, and taped moisture-resistant board on the surrounding walls
The upstairs hall at finishing stage, painted white with doors hung and recessed lighting on, red oak flooring going down under builder's paper, and the new stair posts standing unfinished
The second-floor landing at finishing stage, with oak flooring laid, doors hung and painted, a flush ceiling fixture on, and drop cloths still down on the far side

The new bathroom near completion, with a blue onyx-look tile shower, chrome fixtures and hand shower, an arched white oak wall cabinet, and a wide trough sink, protective film and floor tape still in place

The new second story finished from the street in spring, siding, trim and roofline matched to the original house, with a cherry tree in bloom out front and a dumpster still in the drive as the site is cleared
The completed house from the street, with the full second story built over the two-car garage, clad in matching siding with dark shutters and garage doors, and the lawn re-established
A finished bedroom in the new second story, painted soft blue with white trim, a mirrored closet, a ceiling fan, and red oak flooring
A second finished bedroom in the addition, painted soft blue with white trim and sills, three new windows on two walls, a ceiling fan, and red oak flooring
The finished bathroom, with a blue onyx-look tile shower behind a sliding glass door, a patterned tile niche, an arched white oak wall cabinet, and a pedestal sink
The finished stair landing, with a white oak handrail and newel posts, black metal balusters, and red oak flooring running through to the new bedrooms

The bath during demolition, walls stripped back to the studs with drywall debris across the floor, plumbing stacks and rough electrical boxes exposed, and a work platform standing in the middle of the room
New subfloor and cement-board underlayment down at floor level, with a stud wall framed out for the vanity and rough wiring hanging from the opened wall beside the window
The shower area during rough-in, its curbed base and surrounding walls sheathed in cement board with the drain set in a sloped mortar bed, and orange Ditra underlayment covering the adjoining floor
Large-format marble-look floor tile being set, with yellow levelling clips at every joint, cut pieces staged across the finished run, and the plumbing wall still open to the studs

The finished bath from the doorway: a toilet screened by a half-wall carrying the bidet seat controls, the light oak double vanity with marble-look counters beyond, and the freestanding tub in the window bay
The double vanity run in light oak under brass-framed mirrors and glass sconces, with the freestanding tub and its brass floor-mounted filler at the windows beyond
The double vanity head-on, two undermount sinks set in a marble-look counter with a matching backsplash, brass faucets and pulls, and a pair of brass-framed mirrors beneath glass sconces
The freestanding oval tub centred under the triple casement window, with a brass floor-mounted filler and hand shower and a recessed niche in the wall to the right
The tub bay and the walk-in shower beside it, the shower enclosed in frameless glass with marble-look wall tile and a brass rain head, and two recessed niches in the wall between them

The walk-in shower seen from the bath, frameless glass over a half-wall with a brass towel bar, large-format marble-look wall tile, a brass rain head and hand shower, and a hexagon marble mosaic floor
The shower's glass corner under the skylight, marble-look tile carried up both walls with a rain head on each, and a square drain grate set into the hexagon mosaic floor
Inside the shower, a full wall of marble-look tile with twin rain heads, two brass mixing valves, a hand shower on a holder, and a tiled bench running across the back
Open basement room with an egress window, a white storage cabinet, and the black cable-rail staircase beside a closet with a built-in shelf
Basement rec room with a white painted brick fireplace and black glass doors, an elliptical trainer, and adjustable dumbbells on a rack
Basement bathroom vanity in gray shaker cabinetry with a white integrated sink top, brushed nickel faucet, round mirror, and a wall sconce above
Basement laundry and utility room with a top-load washer and dryer, a white sink cabinet, the electrical panel on the far wall, and a rear exterior door
Laundry room with a stainless utility sink set in white cabinetry, a washer and dryer alongside, and gray double closet doors opposite
Finished basement hallway with gray louvered bifold closet doors and a rolling steel workbench with a butcher-block top along the far wall
Basement utility area with open cedar storage shelving, a rolling steel workbench, and an open door to the room with the white brick fireplace
Basement storage room with open cedar shelving and wire baskets, a white refrigerator, and the laundry room through the opening beyond
Existing hall bathroom with a white raised-panel vanity, speckled granite counter, a wide mirror, and a tiled tub surround reflected behind it
Existing tub and shower surround tiled floor to ceiling in tan stone-look tile with a mosaic border band and two corner shelves
Existing primary bathroom before renovation, with pink walls, a blue-painted corner tub deck, a glass-door shower stall, and the ceiling opened to the roof rafters
Existing primary bath looking across the blue-painted tub deck to the white double vanity, with the ceiling drywall stripped back to the joists and rafters
Existing shower stall with sliding glass doors, cream tile and a floral border, beside the jetted tub on its blue-painted deck
Pink primary bath wall with the toilet, the corner of the jetted tub, and the doorway through to the hardwood hall, ceiling opened above the wall line
Existing white raised-panel vanity with a solid-surface top and full-width mirror, the framing and wiring exposed above it
Existing primary bath with a jetted corner tub on a blue-painted deck under a double-hung window, the glass shower stall at left and open rafters overhead
Adjoining bedroom with yellow walls and light oak flooring looking through the doorway into the primary bath, the ceiling opened to the roof framing
Rebuilt shower alcove coated in red liquid waterproofing membrane over cement board, with a recessed niche and the curb masked in blue tape, sheets of marble-look tile staged against it
Bathroom at rough-in with the drywall taped and mudded around two double-hung windows, floor protection paper down, and joint compound buckets and trowels on the floor
New partition walls hung and taped with a fresh doorway opening cut through, a step ladder and buckets of joint compound on the papered floor
Shower stall framed and boarded in cement board with a recessed niche cut in, insulation exposed at the base, and the black shower pan liner turned up over the curb
Bathroom wall skim-coated over patched drywall where the old fixtures came out, with a step ladder and a roll of floor protection paper against the wall
Shower base with the black pan liner and cement board walls in place beside a double-hung window, a shop vacuum and compound buckets on the papered floor
Tile saw set up on a stand behind plastic dust sheeting taped to the ceiling, with cement board and tile stacked against the wall beside the doorway
Finished hall bath with a white vanity and quartz top, a backlit oval mirror, matte black faucet and towel rings, and a white corner storage cabinet beside the toilet
Marble-look porcelain tub surround with a recessed niche, matte black shower head and valve, and frameless sliding glass doors on a black track
Straight-on view of the finished tub and shower, tiled floor to ceiling in marble-look porcelain with a recessed niche and matte black fittings behind sliding glass
Primary bath looking across the freestanding tub to the white double vanity, with two backlit round mirrors, matte black fixtures, and the toilet in its own alcove
Marble-look walk-in shower with a lit recessed niche and matte black hardware, the freestanding tub visible through the open glass door
Finished primary bath wall in pale blue with a matte black towel shelf, the toilet alcove, and the doorway through to the bedroom
White double vanity with a chevron-panel front, matte black bar pulls and widespread faucets, quartz top, and two backlit round mirrors against pale blue walls
Walk-in closet with white wire shelving on both walls and refinished oak flooring, looking through the doorway to the freestanding tub in the primary bath
Frosted-panel sliding door standing open to the finished hall bath, showing the marble-look tub surround and sliding glass doors beyond
The open hatch seen from the patio, its diamond-plate leaf held upright on a chain, with the deck stairs and the back of the gray-sided house behind it
Looking straight down through the open hatch into the entry shaft, the stainless frame set flush in the concrete pad and the rebar grab bar of the ladder just below the lip
Looking up the rebar ladder from the bottom of the shaft to the open hatch, with blue sky and spring branches above the rim
The barrel-vaulted concrete tunnel looking toward the exit shaft, with the ladder at the far end, a strip light on the right wall and conduit run along it
The same tunnel from the opposite side, the poured concrete vault overhead and the ladder framed in the opening at the end of the run
The tunnel looking the other way toward the shelter, the arched steel door standing open at the end of the vault beside a wall-mounted strip light
The arched steel door closed at the end of the concrete tunnel, its black leaf filling the vaulted opening
Inside the shelter room, corrugated steel deck ceiling over troweled concrete walls and a tiled floor, with the arched steel door in the far right corner
The shelter room looking toward the concrete stair that climbs back into the house, steel deck ceiling above and a capped water stub in the left wall
The shelter room with the arched door open onto the lit tunnel beyond, caged bulkhead lights on either wall fed by surface conduit, and outlets set low
The shelter room with the arched steel door latched shut, a caged bulkhead light overhead, and tiled steps leading up to the doorway into the finished lower level
The passage into the shelter under an exposed steel deck ceiling, a junction box and surface conduit feeding a hanging bulb over the tiled floor
The shelter's vault door standing open, its brass five-spoke handle and pinned edge in the foreground, with the lit concrete passage beyond
The garage before work, one paneled door closed and the second bay standing open on the tan brick elevation under gray lap siding
The same elevation from the driveway before work, the closed paneled door beside the open bay, with a recycling bin at the brick corner
Inside the garage before work, two red steel shoring posts standing under the beam line, a workbench and tool chests along the left wall, and a step up through an open door into the house
The elevation mid-job, the garage opening boarded over with sheathing, a dumpster on the driveway, and ladders up to the second story where the siding has been stripped to felt and Tyvek is going on
The same elevation from across the lawn, showing how far the wrap has been carried along the upper story above the brick, with staging and ladders set against the wall

The garage interior stripped to studs and joists, a grey steel beam carried across the ceiling where the shoring posts had stood, sheathing and insulation exposed on the walls, and a new window opening cut in the far wall
A linear trench drain being set into the concrete at the door threshold, with the slab inside masked in red waterproofing membrane taped off at the edge and bags of concrete mix stacked alongside
A slatwall run going up over the finished epoxy floor, blue tape marking a stud line down the middle of the panels and the top course still open to the blocking above
The finished elevation head-on, two white garage doors with staggered glass panels set in the tan brick under a gray gambrel second story and a copper-capped bay window
The same elevation closer, the paired doors and brick pier centered under the gambrel roof, with a climbing rose on the split-rail fence to the left
The garage wing from across the lawn, the gambrel end and its side dormer in gray siding above the brick, joined back to the house beyond the red maple
The finished interior looking out through both open bays to the lawn and trees, slatwall carried around the walls above a flake epoxy floor and recessed lights across the white ceiling
The interior from the far corner, both doors up on the driveway and the neighbouring house, with the cabinet run and wood workbench along the right-hand wall
The full width of the finished garage, tall gray cabinets and a workbench along the left wall, a glazed door through to the house, and recessed lighting over the flake epoxy floor
One bay open to the fence line, the cabinet run and wood-topped workbench centered on the back wall between slatwall panels
The storage wall in detail, full-height gray cabinets with long steel pulls beside a butcher-block workbench, drawer banks below and upper cabinets over a slatwall backsplash
The garage looking back toward the closed doors, slatwall wrapping the walls to a granite-chip base and the steel post left exposed at the beam line
The rear corner of the finished garage, a white service door on its raised step between slatwall runs, with two new windows looking onto the trees
